title: The Pile: An 800GB Dataset of Diverse Text for Language Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Co-occurrence tests of adjectives and adverbs with binary pronouns ('he' and 'she') weighted by the square root of frequency, alongside average sentiment analysis of the co-occurring words.
Co-occurrence tests and average sentiment analysis of words co-occurring in the same sentence as specific religious terms (e.g., Muslim, Christian, Atheist, Buddhist, Hindu, Jew).
Co-occurrence tests and average sentiment analysis of words co-occurring in the same sentence as racial identifier phrases (e.g., 'black man', 'white woman', 'asian', 'hispanic/latino').
